mapper.sql: id, slug, title, cover_image, seo_text, lead, created_at, sort
mapper.select: SELECT FROM categories ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM categories WHERE slug = #{slug})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (slug, title, cover_image, seo_text, lead, created_at, sort) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{seoText}, #{lead}, #{createdAt}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, seo_text = #{seoText}, lead = #{lead} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE categories SET sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
